# Proficiency Level

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ProficiencyLevel`](gmeow-ProficiencyLevel.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ProficiencyLevel>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An attained proficiency level on a [`gmeow:ProficiencyScale`](gmeow-ProficiencyScale.md) (CEFR A1–C2; Dreyfus novice→expert; NIH beginner→expert; assessed; native; heritage). Carried by [`gmeow:proficiencyLevel`](../properties/gmeow-proficiencyLevel.md) and [`gmeow:skillProficiencyLevel`](../properties/gmeow-skillProficiencyLevel.md); [`gmeow:levelScale`](../properties/gmeow-levelScale.md) ties it to its scale. ILR (0–5) and ACTFL levels are added as further individuals.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ProficiencyLevel`](gmeow-ProficiencyLevel.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for an attained rating on some framework — the rung a language, skill, or knowledge proficiency reaches (CEFR B2, Dreyfus competent, NIH advanced) — referenced from a proficiency relator's level role.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the framework itself (that is [`gmeow:ProficiencyScale`](gmeow-ProficiencyScale.md)) and avoid minting per-level subclasses; levels are individuals, each tied to its scale by [`gmeow:levelScale`](../properties/gmeow-levelScale.md). The knowledge-depth axis has its own dedicated [`gmeow:KnowledgeLevel`](gmeow-KnowledgeLevel.md) value class (cognition).

### How to use

- Mint each rung as an individual in its domain slice, tie it to its framework with [`gmeow:levelScale`](../properties/gmeow-levelScale.md), and cite it from a proficiency relator's level role ([`gmeow:skillProficiencyLevel`](../properties/gmeow-skillProficiencyLevel.md), [`gmeow:proficiencyLevel`](../properties/gmeow-proficiencyLevel.md)); leave cross-scale conversion to a solver-side alignment ledger ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### Examples

- gmeow:levelCefrB2 a [`gmeow:ProficiencyLevel`](gmeow-ProficiencyLevel.md); [`gmeow:levelScale`](../properties/gmeow-levelScale.md) gmeow:scaleCefr.
